name: Inverted arch
summary: It starts at the peak and comes apart: the loudest moment is the first, and the piece is what remains after.
motif: Stated whole and loud at the start; it breaks into fragments, then slows (augmented) as it fades.
surprise: One fragment of the motif comes back whole, once, near the end, then is gone.
ending: A single note, the motif's first, left ringing.
